$comment: Machine-readable inventory of Dessau. Query this FIRST to answer "does this already exist?" — extending what exists is always correct, adding a near-duplicate never is. Hand-maintained, because purpose and accessibility notes cannot be derived from CSS; verified against the implementation by scripts/check-agent-index.mjs, because stale context is worse than none.
name: Dessau
$layersComment: `derivedSystems` is the layer Dessau exists for: a design system built on Dessau, working without it, consumed by products — one per client. It substitutes the foundation (its own primitives.css and semantic.css, Dessau's other ten imports) rather than overriding from a layer above. A product consuming Dessau directly is the second case. See agent/architecture.md and DECISIONS 036, 037.

wording.plurals: DDS.utils.plural(element, count, forms), backed by Intl.PluralRules
wording.note: Tables live beside the behaviour that uses them. Adding a language is a data change; see DECISIONS.md 028.

components.name: actionbar
components.purpose: Keeping the primary action reachable in a long form.
components.accessibility: safe-area-inset-bottom; .dds-actionbar-host reserves scroll space (WCAG 2.4.11).
components.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

components.name: appnav
components.purpose: Flat navigation between the areas of a signed-in application — an account area or a dashboard sidebar. Optional labelled sections and a trailing count per item.
components.notFor: Anything that needs real grouping (use contentnav) or that needs to collapse behind a button (the app is a site — use siteheader). Provides no column of its own: pair it with .dds-sidebar or an app topbar.
components.accessibility: aria-current="page" on the current area, carried by a leading rail in the action colour. The fill and the heavier weight support it and cannot replace it: the fill measures 1.01:1 against the surface behind it in dark mode, so an edge is what survives greyscale and forced colours (#33). Icons are aria-hidden; the visible label carries the meaning. Items are 2.75rem tall for WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: avatar
components.purpose: A person, as an image or initials.
components.accessibility: Initials are aria-hidden; the name goes in real text.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: badge
components.purpose: A short, non-interactive status or category label.
components.accessibility: Status variants pair colour with text AND an icon.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: banner
components.purpose: A page-level or application-level message, full width.
components.notFor: A message about one section — use a notice.
components.accessibility: Only one at a time. No role when present at load; role=status or alert only when it appears.
components.responsive: self — shrinks rather than pushing its neighbours out

components.name: breadcrumb
components.purpose: Where the current page sits in the hierarchy.
components.notFor: A sequence of steps — use step progress.
components.accessibility: ol in a named nav. Separator is a pseudo-element (li:has(> a), not tied to list position, since the scrollable middle nests a second ol). Last entry not a link. Every level stays a real link at every width — nothing is ever hidden.
components.responsive: self — .dds-breadcrumb-scroll-track's nested ol scrolls (overflow-x: auto, no query) once the middle no longer fits; first and last carry flex-shrink: 0 and never give up space. .dds-breadcrumb-scroll (the never-scrolling li) and .dds-breadcrumb-scroll-track (its one child, the actual overflow box) are split apart specifically so the fixed chevron between them and the current page can be ordinary flow content rather than position: sticky, which does not paint correctly before the track's first scroll

components.name: button
components.purpose: An action.
components.accessibility: Name from text or a .dds-sr-only span. Prefer aria-disabled on submits.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: byline
components.purpose: Who wrote or owns something, and how to reach them.
components.accessibility: Avatar aria-hidden, name real text. A contact link names whom it reaches.
components.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

components.name: card
components.purpose: A bounded content group.
components.accessibility: Interactive card: link wraps the heading; .dds-card-target stretches the hit area.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: charcount
components.purpose: A live count under a textarea with maxlength.
components.accessibility: Visible count every keystroke; announcement debounced.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: chart
components.purpose: A bar or donut chart.
components.markup: The bars share one grid: .dds-chart-bars sizes the label and value columns and each .dds-chart-row is subgrid, so every track starts and ends in the same place.
components.accessibility: ALWAYS accompanied by the same data as a real table. Bars are aria-hidden.
components.responsive: self — the label column is a share of the row and wraps beyond it

components.name: chip
components.purpose: A removable token for an applied filter or selected value.
components.notFor: A status label — use a badge.
components.accessibility: The remove button names WHICH filter it removes.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: choice
components.purpose: A checkbox or radio, laid out.
components.accessibility: Radio groups require fieldset + legend. Whole row is the label.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: contentnav
components.purpose: Grouped navigation between the pages of one body of content — a help centre, documentation, a multi-part guide. A sticky column at 64rem of container width and above; a modal panel over the content below it.
components.notFor: Navigation within a single page (use toc), the site's top-level sections (use siteheader), or flat navigation between areas of a signed-in app (use appnav). If it needs no groups, it wants appnav.
components.accessibility: One <nav>, never two copies. Deliberately NOT a <dialog>: the same element must be a static column above the threshold, and the UA closes a dialog with display:none. Instead `inert` goes on [data-dds-contentnav-content] while the panel is open, which removes it from the tab order AND the accessibility tree — what a focus trap only approximates. Escape closes and returns focus to the toggle; following a link closes without restoring focus, so it does not fight the navigation. aria-current="page", since these are other pages.
components.responsive: container — dds-contentnav (inline-size >= 64rem)

components.name: copy
components.purpose: Put a short value on the clipboard from an ordinary button.
components.notFor: A value that needs confirming before it's captured — this copies immediately on click, with no confirmation step.
components.accessibility: Both outcomes announced (DDS.announce) and toasted, in the page's language. No async Clipboard API: the button hides itself rather than doing nothing, leaving the value selectable as ordinary text.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: cta
components.purpose: A prominent block inviting one specific next step.
components.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

components.name: datalist
components.purpose: A list of records with two or three fields each.
components.notFor: Values compared down a column — use a table.
components.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room
components.accessibility: The list carries role="list": Safari drops list semantics from a styled list outside <nav> (agent/accessibility.md).

components.name: date-field
components.purpose: A date, via the native picker.
components.accessibility: autocomplete="bday" for a date of birth; "off" only for a future date. Always give the expected format in a hint.
components.responsive: self — the column count follows the space

components.name: dialog
components.purpose: A modal task or confirmation.
components.accessibility: aria-labelledby required. showModal(), never <dialog open>. Light dismiss is closedby="any"; components.js supplies a feature-detected fallback for engines without it.
components.responsive: viewport — (max-width: 30rem)
components.markup: closedby="any" on the <dialog>. Opened with showModal(), never <dialog open>.

components.name: disclosure
components.purpose: Hiding secondary detail.
components.notFor: Content that must be findable by in-page search.
components.accessibility: No JavaScript. <details name> gives accordion behaviour.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: accordion
components.purpose: A stack of disclosures sharing one border box.
components.notFor: Content that must be findable by in-page search, or seen all at once.
components.accessibility: No JavaScript. A shared <details name> makes the set exclusive; omit it and several may be open.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: divider
components.purpose: A horizontal rule between groups.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: download
components.purpose: A link to a file.
components.accessibility: Format and size in the visible text, not a title.
components.responsive: self — shrinks rather than pushing its neighbours out

components.name: embed
components.purpose: A third-party embed that loads only after consent.
components.notFor: First-party media — use the media component.
components.accessibility: iframe needs a title. No autoplay. Always a plain link to the provider.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: facts
components.purpose: A small set of headline figures.
components.notFor: A data table, or a value long enough to compete with its neighbours — .dds-fact-value is sized for a short figure, not a phrase.
components.accessibility: A real dl, so each figure is paired with its label.
components.responsive: self — the column count follows the space

components.name: field
components.purpose: Label, control, hint, error — the form primitive.
components.notFor: A control without a visible label.
components.accessibility: Visible <label for>. Hint and error in one aria-describedby. Required in words. aria-invalid, never CSS :invalid. Invalid state comes from `:user-invalid` (after the user commits to a value, never `:invalid`, which matches from page load) plus `aria-invalid` for the programmatic state. Positive confirmation is opt-in via `.dds-input-confirm` with `:user-valid`, and its tick is aria-hidden — that a value is acceptable is already carried by the absence of an error.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: fieldgroup
components.purpose: Related controls under one caption.
components.accessibility: Required for radio groups.
components.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

components.name: figure
components.purpose: An image with a caption.
components.notFor: A decorative image with no caption.
components.accessibility: alt replaces, caption supplements. Never interchangeable.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: textmedia
components.purpose: A block of text beside an image, in three layouts: media leading, media trailing, media above.
components.notFor: A layout grid — it is one content block, not a page skeleton.
components.markup: The media element comes first inside .dds-textmedia, in every variant. Below 40rem all three stack with the media on top.
components.accessibility: The media is first in the source, so the stacked layout needs no order and what is announced is what is drawn. The column placement is bound inside the container query (WCAG 1.3.2).
components.responsive: container — dds-textmedia (inline-size > 40rem)

components.name: filterbar
components.purpose: Filter controls plus the chips showing what is applied.
components.accessibility: Applied filters must be visible as removable chips.
components.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

components.name: gallery
components.purpose: A grid of lightbox triggers.
components.responsive: self — the column count follows the space
components.accessibility: The list carries role="list": Safari drops list semantics from a styled list outside <nav> (agent/accessibility.md).

components.name: icon
components.purpose: A decorative glyph beside text.
components.notFor: Carrying meaning on its own — the control gets the name. And never a role borrowed for a meaning it does not have: a wrong <use> resolves, renders and passes every check. If the role is missing, add it to ICON_MAP in scripts/build-icons.mjs — see agent/foundations.md#icons.
components.accessibility: Always aria-hidden. The sprite must be inlined per document.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: kbd
components.purpose: A key or key combination.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: keyvalue
components.purpose: Paired labels and values.
components.responsive: self — the label column is a share of the row and wraps beyond it

components.name: lightbox
components.purpose: An enlarged view of an image.
components.notFor: Content that is not an image.
components.accessibility: Trigger is a real <a href> opening in a new tab without JS. Arrow keys, Escape, position announced.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: media
components.purpose: Self-hosted video or audio.
components.accessibility: Video with speech requires <track kind=captions> (WCAG 1.2.2).
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: menu
components.purpose: A list of actions revealed from a button.
components.accessibility: popover + popovertarget, no JS. Buttons/links in a list, NOT role=menu. The list carries role="list": Safari drops list semantics from a styled list outside <nav> (agent/accessibility.md). Disabled item: aria-disabled, not disabled, so it stays focusable; the consumer's click handler must check it.
components.responsive: self — capped to the viewport less a gutter, so it cannot be wider than the screen

components.name: notice
components.purpose: A contextual message attached to the page or a section.
components.notFor: A transient confirmation — use a toast.
components.accessibility: Role depends on WHEN it appears: none / role=status / role=alert.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: password
components.purpose: A password field and its reveal toggle. Added automatically to every <input type="password">; you do not write this markup.
components.notFor: A field that must never be readable — opt out with data-dds-password="off".
components.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication: typing a long password blind is a cognitive function test, so the reveal is a requirement and therefore not opt-in — `type="password"` is the opt-in signal (see DECISIONS.md). A real <button type="button"> whose accessible name stays CONSTANT, with the state in aria-pressed; a button that renames itself is announced as a different control each time. Only `type` changes — `autocomplete` is never rewritten and paste is never blocked, because the password manager is what makes 3.3.8 satisfiable. The change is announced via DDS.announce. The caret is restored after the type switch. A disabled field disables its toggle. Without JavaScript: an ordinary masked input that still submits. data-dds-password takes one value, "off", which leaves the field alone; the wording comes from the nearest [lang] (en, de), never from an attribute repeating what <html lang> already says. An authored toggle is wired rather than duplicated, and an input already inside .dds-password or .dds-input-group is not wrapped again.
components.responsive: self — shrinks rather than pushing its neighbours out

components.name: pagination
components.purpose: Navigation between pages of a list.
components.accessibility: Real links with hrefs. Names say where they go. aria-current=page.
components.responsive: container — dds-pagination (inline-size < 28rem)

components.name: progress
components.purpose: Determinate progress.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: progress-ring
components.purpose: Determinate progress as a circle, where a bar does not fit.
components.notFor: Anything wide enough for a bar — a bar reads more accurately.
components.accessibility: aria-hidden. The value goes on a real <progress> or in text beside it.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: quote
components.purpose: A pulled-out quotation.
components.accessibility: figure + blockquote + figcaption. Attribution outside the quotation.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: range
components.purpose: A value where the exact number does not matter.
components.accessibility: Value always shown as text and announced.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: search
components.purpose: A query input and its submit button as one unit.
components.notFor: A filter control — use the filter bar.
components.markup: A <form> inside a <search>. The element carries the landmark; role="search" is not used.
components.accessibility: The <search> element is the landmark — ARIA supplements semantics rather than replacing them. A real submit button with a name, never an unnamed magnifier. enterkeyhint="search", because Enter submits a search.
components.responsive: self — shrinks rather than pushing its neighbours out

components.name: segmented
components.purpose: Two to four exclusive options, all visible.
components.notFor: More than four, or long labels.
components.accessibility: Radio inputs: one tab stop, arrow keys. Selected changes fill AND weight.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: sitefooter
components.purpose: Grouped footer links and a closing line.
components.accessibility: Each group a named nav or a list under a heading.
components.responsive: container — dds-sitefooter (inline-size >= 40rem)

components.name: siteheader
components.purpose: Product name and primary navigation.
components.accessibility: One nav, one DOM location. aria-expanded + aria-controls, not role=menu. hidden attribute. The toggle carries both the menu and close sprite icons; aria-expanded cross-fades between them. With data-dds-drawer the open nav is a modal panel: inert page content, scroll lock, and a data-dds-nav-close button first in the panel; Escape, scrim-click and that button close and restore focus.
components.responsive: container — dds-siteheader (inline-size >= 48rem)

components.name: skeleton
components.purpose: A placeholder whose shape is known before its data.
components.accessibility: aria-hidden; the region carries aria-busy.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: specs
components.purpose: A longer, homogeneous list of properties and values.
components.notFor: A handful of pairs in a summary — use the key-value list.
components.accessibility: A real dl. The leader dots are generated content, so they are not read aloud.
components.responsive: self — shrinks rather than pushing its neighbours out

components.name: spinner
components.purpose: Indeterminate progress.
components.accessibility: aria-hidden. Pair with text in a role=status region. Non-moving fallback under reduced motion.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: stepper
components.purpose: A quantity the user adjusts rather than types once.
components.accessibility: Buttons disable at the limits; the new value is announced.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: steps
components.purpose: Position within a multi-step process.
components.accessibility: Status in words. aria-current=step. Upcoming steps are never links. The list carries role="list": Safari drops list semantics from a styled list outside <nav> (agent/accessibility.md).
components.responsive: container — dds-steps (inline-size >= 34rem)

components.name: switch
components.purpose: A setting that takes effect immediately.
components.notFor: A value submitted with a form — use a checkbox.
components.accessibility: role="switch" over a real checkbox. Forced colours: border weight changes. Icon variant (.dds-switch-icon): both state icons are real <svg> elements inside .dds-switch-track (aria-hidden, same as the track), CSS shows the one matching the checked state and positions it as the thumb; the visible label stays constant, the icon carries the state.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: table
components.purpose: Tabular data.
components.accessibility: th scope, a caption, and a focusable named wrapper for overflow.
components.responsive: self — the scroll region takes the overflow, so a wide table never widens the page

components.name: tabs
components.purpose: Alternative views of one thing.
components.notFor: Content that should be readable in sequence or linkable.
components.accessibility: One tab stop, arrow keys, Home/End. aria-selected + hidden are the state.
components.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

components.name: teaser
components.purpose: A card promoting something elsewhere.
components.accessibility: Link wraps the heading text; the card grows the hit area.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: theme-toggle
components.purpose: Switching between light and dark, styled as a text link.
components.notFor: Any other binary setting — use a switch.
components.accessibility: An action button: the label and accessible name describe the NEXT state, so there is NO aria-pressed. Combining a changing name with aria-pressed double-encodes the state. Both icons are in the markup; CSS chooses. Wording — label, accessible name and announcement alike — follows the nearest [lang]; data-dds-theme-toggle takes no value, and one left over from when it named a language is warned about and ignored.
components.responsive: self — shrinks rather than pushing its neighbours out

components.name: toast
components.purpose: Confirming something that just happened.
components.notFor: Anything the user must read or act on.
components.accessibility: role=status region. Timer pauses on hover and focus. duration 0 stays.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: toc
components.purpose: In-page anchor navigation for a long document.
components.accessibility: aria-current="location", not "page": the reading position moved, the user did not navigate. Measured geometrically against a reading line, not with an IntersectionObserver band, which can never activate the last entry. The list scrolls its own scroll box to keep the marked entry in view — scrollTop on that one box, never scrollIntoView, which would move the page too.
components.responsive: self — the reading mark exists only where the list is sticky, so on a phone it does not claim one

components.name: toolbar
components.purpose: A grouped row of controls above a list or editor.
components.accessibility: role=toolbar only when there are enough controls to justify it.
components.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

components.name: tooltip
components.purpose: Supplementary text for a control that already has a name.
components.markup: Only the icon is the button. The term beside it stays text; the trigger is an icon-only button with a name that identifies the term.
components.accessibility: popover gives the WCAG 1.4.13 dismiss behaviour. The trigger carries aria-describedby as well as popovertarget, because opening a popover moves no focus and announces nothing.
components.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

components.name: topbar
components.purpose: Application chrome naming the current context and its actions.
components.notFor: Wayfinding between pages — use the site header.
components.accessibility: The context title is a real heading, so the outline reflects where the user is.
components.responsive: container — dds-topbar (inline-size < 34rem)

components.name: upload
components.purpose: Choosing files.
components.notFor: The only route being drag and drop.
components.accessibility: accept must match the prose. Drag and drop is additive (WCAG 2.5.7). The list carries role="list": Safari drops list semantics from a styled list outside <nav> (agent/accessibility.md).
components.responsive: self — shrinks rather than pushing its neighbours out

patterns.name: combobox
patterns.purpose: A text input with filtered suggestions, over any source.
patterns.notFor: A short known list — use a select.
patterns.accessibility: Focus stays in the input; aria-activedescendant marks the active option. Two-stage Escape. Debounced announcements. AbortController.
patterns.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

patterns.name: address-search
patterns.purpose: Filling structured address fields from a search, over a replaceable provider.
patterns.accessibility: Fields always present and editable. Street+number one field. Secondary line never auto-filled. autocomplete on every field. Filling is announced.

patterns.name: form
patterns.purpose: Layout and rhythm for a form.
patterns.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

patterns.name: form-validation
patterns.notFor: Server validation — this never replaces it.
patterns.accessibility: Errors on submit only, then on blur. Summary at the top, focus moves to it, entries link to fields, wording matches.
patterns.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

patterns.name: results
patterns.purpose: A query and its outcome, in four states.
patterns.accessibility: aria-busy while loading; count announced politely. Failed is worded differently from nothing found. The list carries role="list": Safari drops list semantics from a styled list outside <nav> (agent/accessibility.md).
patterns.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

patterns.name: empty
patterns.purpose: When there is nothing to show.
patterns.accessibility: Nothing yet and nothing found are different messages. Never a bare "No data".
patterns.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

patterns.name: conditional-fields
patterns.purpose: Fields that appear because of an earlier answer.
patterns.accessibility: hidden attribute, not CSS. aria-expanded + aria-controls. Focus is NOT moved in.
patterns.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

patterns.name: wizard
patterns.purpose: A process with a genuine sequence.
patterns.accessibility: Back never discards input. Hidden steps disabled so they cannot block submit. Focus to the new heading, announced.
patterns.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

patterns.name: review
patterns.purpose: The last screen before something happens.
patterns.accessibility: Every submitted value shown. Each Change control names what it changes.
patterns.responsive: self — wraps when it runs out of room

patterns.name: derived-output
patterns.purpose: A read-only value worked out from user input.
patterns.accessibility: Output as a dl, aria-live polite. Incomplete is not an error. Cleared when input changes.
patterns.responsive: self — the label column is a share of the row and wraps beyond it

patterns.name: auth
patterns.purpose: Signing in, and recovering access: sign-in, a one-time code, and a password reset in three steps (request, code, new password). The reveal toggle is not here — it belongs to the `password` component and is automatic.
patterns.accessibility: WCAG 2.2 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication. `autocomplete="new-password"` on BOTH password fields, so a manager can generate and save; `off` on either one disables the manager rather than the autofill. Never block paste. One field for a code, never six boxes. The reset code is alphanumeric with `inputmode="text"` — a numeric keypad cannot type letters. A mismatch is reported once the confirmation is at least as long as the first entry or the field is left, via `role="status"`, and the text is only rewritten when it changes so it is not repeated per keystroke. Never a clickable reset link in the email: a bearer credential in an inbox is forwarded, pre-fetched by mail scanners, and lands the user in a different browser. Identical response and timing whether or not an account exists.
patterns.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

patterns.name: filtering
patterns.purpose: Narrowing a list, and telling what has been narrowed.
patterns.accessibility: Applied filters always visible as chips. Count announced. Filter state in the URL is the product's job — DDS renders and announces it, and does not navigate.

patterns.name: upload-flow
patterns.purpose: Choosing files, seeing them checked, recovering from a rejection.
patterns.notFor: Simple file selection — use the upload component.
patterns.accessibility: A rejection says why and what to do. One failure does not discard the others.
patterns.responsive: none — nothing about it changes with width

patterns.name: consent-gate
patterns.purpose: A page-level, remembered opt-in that blocks a script until it is granted.
patterns.notFor: One third-party embed — use the embed component, which forgets the choice.
patterns.accessibility: role=dialog, non-modal. No implicit consent: no dismiss, Escape does nothing. Decline is equal weight, never subtle. Focus moves in only on re-open, never traps. Announced politely.
patterns.responsive: self — full-width on a phone, capped at a readable measure on a wide screen
